author: C

components.title: Puzzle setup
components.what: Model five houses numbered 1 to 5, assigning each exactly one resident, drink, pet, and color from the listed sets, with no value repeated within each category.

components.title: Clues
components.what: Apply all 13 stated clues, including positional, adjacency, ownership, identity, drink, and color constraints.

components.title: Deduction task
components.what: Determine which resident keeps the bird, using the clues and the assertion that the solution is unique.

components.title: Output requirements
components.what: Show brief working, then end with exactly one line in the form FINAL: <answer>; return the requested critique as JSON only.

log.draft:
Working:
- Clues 4, 1, 7, 12, 5, 6 give H1: Dev, blue, juice, horse; H5: Cleo, yellow; H3: cat.
- Tea must be next to blue H1, so H2 has tea. H2 is not red/coffee; green cannot be H2 because then Eli would be H1 (Dev), so H2 is white. Thus green/red are H3/H4.
- If green were H3, Eli would be H2; red H4 would be coffee. Then milk must be H3 with dog H4, leaving water H5; but water H5 next to fish would force fish H4, contradicting dog H4. So green is H4, red is H3, Eli is H3, and coffee is H3.
- Milk immediately left of dog: with H4/H5 drinks milk/water, milk must be H4 and dog H5; water is H5. Water next to fish forces fish H4.
- Pets: H1 horse, H3 cat, H4 fish, H5 dog, so H2 bird.
- Residents: H1 Dev, H3 Eli, H5 Cleo; Ada not H4, so Ada is H2, Ben is H4. Therefore Ada keeps the bird.

FINAL: Ada

challenges.problem: The cited clue list omits clue 11, which is the source of the H3 cat assignment.

The draft omits the case where H5 drinks milk instead of water when testing green at H3, failing to explicitly rule out milk in H5 (which is impossible only because house 6 does not exist for the dog).
The deduction does not explicitly prove why milk cannot be H5 to force water into H4, which would instead place the fish at H3 or H5, potentially conflicting with cat at H3 or dog at H6.

log.answer:
Working:
- Direct clues: Clues 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12 establish H1 = (Dev, blue, juice, horse), H3 pet = cat, H5 = (Cleo, yellow).
- Clue 9: Tea is next to blue (H1), so H2 drinks tea.
- Colors & Eli (Clue 3): Remaining colors for H2, H3, H4 are red, green, white. Green cannot be H2 since Eli would be H1 (Dev). If green were H3, Eli would be H2, making H4 red/coffee. Then drinks for H3, H5 are milk, water; milk cannot be H5 (needs a dog to its right per Clue 2, but no H6 exists), so H3 drinks milk (dog at H4), leaving water at H5; then fish next to water requires fish at H4, clashing with dog at H4. Thus, green is H4, red is H3 (coffee at H3 per Clue 10), H2 is white, and Eli lives in H3 (Clue 3).
- Drinks: H4 and H5 must take milk and water. Milk cannot be H5 (no H6 for dog), so H4 drinks milk, H5 drinks water, and H5 owns the dog (Clue 2).
- Pets: Fish is next to water (H5), so H4 has the fish (Clue 8). With H1 horse, H3 cat, H4 fish, H5 dog, H2 must have the bird.
- Residents: H1 Dev, H3 Eli, H5 Cleo. Since Ada is not in H4 (Clue 13), Ada is in H2 and Ben is in H4.
Thus, Ada keeps the bird.

FINAL: Ada
